item.title: [Kuroinu Gaiden] Elf Mura no Kanraku ~Chijoku to Kairaku no Utage~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Liquid, Herencia
  • 発売日: 2016-10-28
  • スコア: 7.33/10 (108 人評価)
  • 日本語名: ［黒獣外伝］エルフ村の姦落 ～恥辱と快楽の宴～
  • 英語名: [Kuroinu Gaiden] Elf Mura no Kanraku Chijoku to Kairaku no Utage

あらすじ

The time when the “Service State” was founded on the Eos Plain in the western part of the Serenus continent, Morgan, the leader of a band of ruffian mercenaries, encounters the finest prey in a village he raids.

The wife of the lord, the noble high elf “Anna”, and Grace, a young widow and rare dark elf.
